app.name: MissionPilot AI
app.engine_ai_help: Documents, plans and chat are written by Claude
app.template_help: AI writing is off: plans and documents come from the professional template library. Add a Claude API key on the server to turn it on.
app.ml_help: A small pre-trained model runs on this server for free: it suggests risk/task categories, finds duplicate risks and reads meeting notes. You always decide.

auth.name: Your name
auth.invalid: Please fill in your name, a valid email and a password of at least 8 characters.
auth.exists: An account with this email already exists.

landing.meta: Type a project name. Answer a few questions. Get the full plan, Gantt chart, documents and reports — in your language.
landing.title: Your whole project plan from one sentence
landing.lead: Type the project name and a short description. MissionPilot asks about budget, team and duration, then builds the tasks, Gantt chart, risks, budget and every project document — and tracks progress until the end.
landing.langs_note: Works fully in your language — interface, documents, reports and voice guide:
landing.sample_prompt: SOC platform for a bank — detect UPI and card fraud in real time with AI
outputs: 35+ tasks with dates, owners and dependencies
landing.f1_d: A short question popup — budget, team, roles, duration — then the full plan in seconds.
landing.f2_d: Dependencies, resources, critical path, today line. Download for MS Project, Excel or PDF.
landing.f3_d: Charter, BRD, SRS, architecture, test plan, risk assessment and more — Word and PDF.
landing.f4_d: See what is done and what is left for each task, as a colour-coded bar graph.
landing.f5_d: Interface, documents, reports and the voice guide in English, French and Marathi — more languages coming.
landing.f6_d: New users get a spoken tour that shows where everything is.
landing.footer: Plans, documents and tracking for every project

new.title: What are we building?

new.hint: Enter to continue · Shift+Enter for a new line
new.too_short: Please write a few more words about the project.

E-commerce website for a clothing shop

q.team: How many people are in the team?
q.members: Who is in the team, and what is each person's role?
q.members_help: Names are optional. Roles are suggested for this type of project — change them if needed.
q.duration: How long should the project take?
q.type: What kind of project is it?

home.desc: Overview: progress, deadlines, budget and what happens next.
home.created: Your project is ready — {n} tasks planned. Have a look around, then open Documents.

kpi.pv_d: Budgeted cost of the work planned until today.
kpi.ev_d: Budgeted cost of the work actually done.
kpi.ac_d: What has been spent so far.
kpi.spi_d: EV ÷ PV. Below 1 means behind schedule.
kpi.cpi_d: EV ÷ AC. Below 1 means over budget for the work done.
kpi.eac_d: Expected total cost if spending continues at the current rate.

health.help: Verdict from schedule, cost, overdue work, workload and milestones.

legend.title: Colour code
legend.critical_path: on the critical path (any delay moves the end date)

tasks.desc: Every task with its owner, dates and progress. Move the slider to update progress — the Gantt chart and reports follow.
tasks.reschedule_note: Changing an end date moves every task that depends on it.

gantt.title: Gantt chart
gantt.desc: Timeline with dependencies, resources, critical path and today's date. Download it for Microsoft Project.
gantt.legend_critical_help: On the critical path: any delay moves the project end date.
gantt.ms_help: MS Project: File › Open › choose the .xml file. It opens with tasks, dates, dependencies, resources and % complete. ProjectLibre and GanttProject open it too.

progress.title: Progress — done and left
progress.desc: How far the project has come: what is done, what is ongoing, what is left — per task, per phase and over time.
progress.by_task_help: each bar is one task — green is done, orange is what is left (in % and days)
progress.weekly_help: bars = tasks finished that week · line = total % done
progress.burndown_title: Burndown chart — work left each day
progress.burndown_help: orange = real work left, dashed = ideal pace; the red line is today
progress.today_day: Today: day {n} of {total} · {left} days of work left
progress.bd_future: This day is still in the future
progress.bd_will_done_by: Planned to be done by day {n}

budget.desc: Planned against actual spending by category, with earned-value indicators. Type the amounts actually spent.
budget.help: Tip: update actual spending every week so the cost index (CPI) stays meaningful.
budget.remaining_help: Planned minus actual for each line (money not spent yet). The cost variance is shown by CPI.

risks.desc: Risk register with probability, impact, owner and mitigation. The matrix shows where the biggest risks are.
risks.matrix_help: Red = act now, orange = watch closely, yellow = monitor, green = accept.
risks.auto_help: Raised by a rule from the project data (workload, overdue tasks, plan, CPI/SPI, milestones). It is a warning signal, never confirmed automatically, and it is cleared by itself when the cause disappears.
risks.bands_note: Score = probability × impact. Low 1–5 (green), medium 6–11 (yellow), high 12–15 (orange), critical 16–25 (red) — the same colours as the matrix.

riskstatus.cleared_help: The data no longer shows this problem. It re-opens automatically if it comes back.

team.desc: Team members, roles and workload week by week. Red cells mean someone has more than 40 hours planned.
team.overload_fix: Fix: move a task's end date, change the owner in Tasks, or add a person.

reports.desc: Daily, weekly and monthly reports from live project data, in any language. Download as PDF or Word, or share a link.
reports.lang_note: The report language can differ from the interface language. Numbers are identical in every language.

reportdesc.daily: What changed today, tasks due soon, blocked work.
reportdesc.weekly: Progress this week, completed tasks, next week's plan, top risks.
reportdesc.monthly: Health, KPIs, milestones, budget and risks for management.
reportdesc.missed: Overdue tasks, how late they are and what to do.
reportdesc.budget: Planned vs actual by category, earned value (CPI, SPI, EAC).
reportdesc.risk: Risk matrix and full register sorted by score.
reportdesc.workload: Hours per person per week and overload warnings.

docs.desc: All project documents, generated from your project data. Pick a language, create, then download Word or PDF, or share.
docs.use_ai: Let Claude write the text sections
docs.template_mode: Professional templates (add a Claude API key for AI writing)
docs.zip_note: “Download everything” gives you all 14 documents in Word and PDF, plus the MS Project file and the Excel workbook, in one ZIP.

share.title: Share this document
share.note: Anyone with the link can view and download it. You can stop sharing at any time.
share.file_unsupported: This device cannot share files — use the link instead.
share.shared_note: Shared with you from MissionPilot AI.

assistant.desc: Ask anything about the project, in any language — by typing or with the microphone.
assistant.placeholder: Ask about progress, overdue tasks, budget, risks…
assistant.hello: Hello! I know everything in “{project}”. Ask me what is late, what is next, how the budget looks, or anything else.
assistant.mic_note: 🎤 The microphone works in Chrome and Edge. You can speak in one language and get the answer in another.
assistant.local_banner: Claude AI is not connected, so answers come from the project data (status, overdue, budget, risks, next tasks, team). Add a Claude API key on the server for full conversations.
assistant.local_note: (Answer built from project data. Connect Claude for free-form questions.)
assistant.needs_key: This needs a Claude API key on the server.

settings.desc: Your languages, formats and voice guide.
settings.languages_help: Each one can be different — for example the interface in English and documents in French.
settings.review_note: Translations marked “needs native review” were machine-translated. A native speaker should check them before production.
settings.ai_howto: Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on the server to turn on Claude.

help.desc: Short guides for every feature. Start the voice tour any time.
create_s: Write the project name and one sentence about it.
Answer the questions in the popup: budget, team, roles, duration, type, start date.
Wait a few seconds — tasks, Gantt, budget, risks and documents are ready.
questions_s: Click an answer, or press its number key.
Choose “Other…” to type your own value.
Use the chips at the top to go back to any question.
You can rename the project at the top of the popup.
progress_s: Move the slider of a task (0–100 %).
Or change the status: Not started, In progress, Blocked, Done.
Progress tracking, Gantt and reports update at once.
gantt_s: Open Gantt chart and choose Days, Weeks or Months.
Red outline = critical path, red line = today.
Download “MS Project” and open the .xml file in Microsoft Project.
Excel and PDF versions are also available.
docs_s: Press Create next to a document.
Download Word or PDF — or “Download everything” as a ZIP.
share_s: Copy the link, or send it by WhatsApp, email or LinkedIn.
Press “Stop sharing” to turn the link off.
reports_s: Create a daily, weekly, monthly, missed-task, budget, risk or workload report.
languages_s: Change the language at the top right — every page changes.
In Settings choose separate languages for the interface, AI answers, documents and reports.
Numbers, dates and money follow the language's format.
Settings shows how complete each language is.
voice_s: Use Pause, Replay, Mute and Speed in each step.
If your device has no voice for a language, the text is shown instead (Microsoft Edge has the most voices).
assistant_s: Type or press the microphone and speak.
Choose the answer language at the top.
Ask about status, delays, budget, risks or next steps.
budget_s: Type the amount actually spent per category.
Watch CPI and SPI: below 1.00 needs attention.
live_s: Read DEPLOY.md in the project folder.
Create a Web Service on Render from the repository (Docker).
Add SECRET_KEY (and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for Claude) and deploy.
email_s: Google Account → Security → turn on 2-Step Verification.
Open myaccount.google.com/apppasswords, name it “MissionPilot”, press Create and copy the 16-character password.

Render dashboard → the missionpilot-ai service → Environment → add SMTP_USER (your Gmail address), SMTP_PASSWORD (the App password) and EMAIL_TO (where demo and admin e-mails go). Save: Render restarts the site.
In MissionPilot: Settings → E-mail sending → Send a test e-mail. The log shows Sent or the exact error.
autorisks_s: The verdict on Home (On track / At risk / Critical) and its top 3 reasons are recalculated every time a page opens.
Risks marked ⚙ Automatic come from rules on your data: overload above 40 h × availability, overdue critical-path tasks, more than 3 points behind plan, CPI or SPI below 0.95, milestones at risk.
Each one says why it was raised. When the cause disappears it becomes “Condition cleared”; if it returns it re-opens.
Only a person can mark a risk as Confirmed (Evidence column).
whatif_s: Open What-if, pick a person and the dates.
See which tasks move, the new end date and who has free hours to take over.
Give a task to someone else (they get an e-mail) or save the new dates. Nothing changes before you decide.
notes_s: Open Meeting notes → tasks and paste the notes (English, French or Marathi).
Press Find action items: owner, deadline and priority are detected.
Edit the preview, untick what you do not want, then create the tasks. Owners are e-mailed.
help.import_t: Import from Excel, Trello or Jira
import_s: Upload an .xlsx/.csv file, a Trello JSON export or a Jira CSV export (templates are provided).
Check the column mapping and the preview (errors are listed per row), then create the project.
help.client_t: Share a read-only page with your client
client_s: The client sees the verdict, progress, milestones and Gantt chart — never the budget, internal risks or e-mails.
Set an expiry, see every visit in the log and revoke the link at any time.

tour.button_help: Start the guided tour with voice
tour.welcome_d: Take a 2-minute tour. I will show you each part of the app and read it aloud in your language.
tour.s1_d: Every page is here, numbered in order: home, projects, tasks, Gantt, progress, budget, risks, team, reports, documents, assistant, settings and help.
tour.s2_d: Choose your language here. The whole app changes — menus, documents, reports and this voice guide.
tour.s3_d: Press here, write the project name and one sentence. Answer a few questions — budget, team, roles, duration — and the full plan is created.
tour.s4_d: These cards show progress against the plan, finished and overdue tasks, work left and the budget used.
tour.s5_d: Every task with its owner and dates. Move a slider to update progress. Colours show status, and dots show priority.
tour.s6_d: The timeline with dependencies, resources and today's date. The red outline is the critical path. Download it for Microsoft Project, Excel or PDF.
tour.s7_d: For each task, green is done and orange is what is left, in percent and days. Below you see ongoing and completed tasks.
tour.s8_d: Planned against actual spending per category. Type what you spent; the cost index tells you if you are on budget.
tour.s9_d: The risk matrix. Red squares are the biggest risks. Each risk has an owner and a mitigation plan.
tour.s10_d: Hours planned per person each week. Red means someone is overloaded.
tour.s11_d: Create daily, weekly and monthly reports in any language, then download them as PDF or Word, or share a link.
tour.s12_d: All 14 project documents — charter, requirements, architecture, test plan and more. Create, download in Word or PDF, or share.
tour.s13_d: Ask questions about the project by typing or speaking. Answers come in the language you choose.
tour.s14_d: You can restart this tour any time with this button. Good luck with your project!

voice.stt_unsupported: Voice input needs Chrome or Edge.
voice.test_phrase: Hello! This is the MissionPilot voice guide.
voice.unavailable: No voice for this language on this device.
voice.unavailable_tour: No voice for this language on this device — read the text below. (Microsoft Edge has the most voices.)
voice.blocked: The browser paused the voice. Press Replay to hear this step.

js.confirm_delete: Delete this project and everything in it?
js.generating: Creating… this takes a few seconds
js.reassigned: Task reassigned — the new owner is e-mailed.
js.confirm_apply_dates: Save the new dates? Dependent tasks will move.
js.confirm_revoke: Revoke this link? The client will no longer see the page.

demo.badge: Demo workspace — changes are yours only and reset after 24 h.

tr.machine_help: Translated by AI, not yet reviewed.
tr.untranslated_help: Not translated yet — shown in the project's original language.
tr.outdated_help: The original text changed after this translation.

projects.desc: All your projects with their progress. Open one or start a new one.
projects.empty: No projects yet. Create your first one — it takes one sentence.

verdict.help: Calculated from the project data every time you open the page.

r.over_budget: More money spent than the whole budget.

overdue_crit.one: {n} overdue task is on the critical path (it moves the end date).
overdue_crit.other: {n} overdue tasks are on the critical path (they move the end date).

r.spi: Schedule index (SPI) is {v} — less work done than planned.
r.cpi: Cost index (CPI) is {v} — work costs more than planned.
r.overload: {name} is planned for {h} h in one week (more than capacity).

g.progress: Progress is {pts} points ahead of plan.
g.close: Progress is close to plan ({pts} points).
g.budget: Spending is in line with the work done.

overload.m: Move a task to someone with free time (see What-if), shift a deadline or lower the scope for that week.
overload.why: {name} is planned for {h} h in the week of {week} (capacity {cap} h); overloaded weeks still to come: {weeks}.

overdue_crit.m: Unblock or add people to these tasks first: every day they slip moves the end date.
overdue_crit.why: {n} overdue task(s) on the critical path ({tasks}), up to {days} working days late.

behind.m: Re-plan the next two weeks, protect the critical path and check whether the end date is still realistic.
behind.why: {actual} % done today while the plan expected {planned} % ({pts} points behind).

cpi.m: Review the actual spending per category and the remaining estimates; act before the contingency is used up.
cpi.why: Cost performance index CPI = {v} (below 0.95): each euro spent produced less than a euro of planned work.

spi.m: Find the tasks that fall behind, remove blockers and check the resource plan.
spi.why: Schedule performance index SPI = {v} (below 0.95): less work is done than planned by today.

milestone.m: Finish or re-assign the late tasks before the milestone, or agree a new milestone date.
milestone.why: Milestone {wbs} on {date}: {n} task(s) before it are late or blocked; the busiest person still needs {need} days of work and {avail} working days are left.

ai.model_on: Model: {model}, running free on this server.
ai.model_off: AI model not loaded — suggestions use keyword rules only.
ai.chip_help: Category suggested by the on-server AI model (confidence {pct}).
ai.tasks_note: ✦ chips = category suggested by the AI model.
ai.model_row_help: Free, pre-trained, multilingual (EN/FR/मराठी). Runs on the server; no data leaves it.

whatif.desc: Simulate an absence before it happens: which tasks move, the new end date and who could take over. Nothing changes until you decide.
whatif.question: If this person is absent…
whatif.no_impact: {name} has no unfinished work during these dates: no impact.
whatif.summary_late: If {name} is absent, {n} task(s) move and the project ends {days} working day(s) later — unless someone takes over.
whatif.summary_ok: If {name} is absent, {n} task(s) move but the end date stays the same (there is slack).
whatif.decide_help: Either give the person's tasks to someone else (buttons above — they receive an e-mail), or keep them and save the new dates (dependent tasks move, the team is e-mailed).
whatif.apply_dates: Keep the person, save the new dates
whatif.empty: Choose a team member and dates, then press Simulate.

notes.desc: Paste meeting notes in English, French or Marathi. MissionPilot finds the action items — task, owner, deadline, priority. You check and edit them before anything is created.
notes.placeholder: e.g. Lucas will finish the detection rules by Friday (urgent)…
notes.engine_rules_model: Engine: rules + free on-server AI model.
notes.preview_help: Untick what you do not want; edit any cell.
notes.example:
Steering meeting — notes
- Lucas will finish the detection rules by Friday (urgent)
- Sofia to update the architecture document before 3 Nov
Action: Anaya prepares the steering committee slides tomorrow
Sofia doit corriger les bugs de connexion avant mardi.
The weather was nice and everybody attended.
notes.nothing: No action item found. Write one action per line, with a name and a date.

client.title: Client share link
client.desc: A secret read-only page for your client: verdict, progress, milestones and Gantt chart.
client.shows: The client sees: verdict, progress, milestones, Gantt. The client never sees: budget, internal risks, team e-mails.
client.label: Name (for you)
client.privacy: Every visit is logged with the time, a pseudonymous visitor number and the browser (no IP address is stored). Revoke a link at any time.
client.gone: This link has expired or was revoked. Ask the project manager for a new one.
client.readonly_note: Read-only project status shared by the project manager.

imp.title: Import an existing project
imp.desc: Bring a project from Excel/CSV, Trello or Jira. You map the columns, check the preview, then create the project.
imp.formats: Excel (.xlsx), CSV, Trello board export (.json), Jira export (.csv). Up to 2 000 rows, 5 MB.
imp.how_export: How do I export from Trello or Jira?
imp.how_trello: Trello: board menu → … More → Print, export and share → Export as JSON.
imp.how_jira: Jira: Filters → search the issues → Export → Export CSV (all fields or current fields).
imp.how_excel: Excel / MS Project: one row per task with a header row (task, owner, start, end, progress…). Our template shows the format.
imp.name: Project name
imp.n_errors: {n} row(s) with errors will be skipped:
imp.guessed: No date in the file: 5 working days were planned after the owner's previous task.
imp.phase_note: The phase is suggested from the group/list name and the task name (keywords + on-server AI model). You can move tasks later.
imp.done: Project imported: {n} tasks. Risks, budget lines and the verdict were added automatically.

err.too_big: The file is larger than 5 MB.
err.empty: No rows found in the file.
err.read: The file could not be read. Save it again as .xlsx or .csv (UTF-8).
err.trello: This JSON is not a Trello board export.
err.bad_date: date not understood (use YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY)
err.end_before_start: end date is before start date
err.bad_progress: progress must be a number from 0 to 100
err.map_title: Choose which column holds the task name.

mail.deadline: The end date of “{task}” changed from {old} to {new}. Dependent tasks moved: {n}.
mail.blocked: “{task}” ({name}) is marked as blocked. Please check what is needed to unblock it.

overdue_intro.one: This task passed its end date and is not finished:
overdue_intro.other: These {n} tasks passed their end date and are not finished:

mail.overload: {name} is planned for {h} h in the week of {week} (capacity {cap} h).
mail.overload_fix: Open What-if to see who could take over, or move a deadline.
mail.weekly_attach: The full weekly report is attached (Word).
mail.test: This test e-mail shows that sending through Gmail works. Sent at {time}.
mail.footer: You receive this because you own this project in MissionPilot AI. Turn e-mails off in Settings.
mail.footer_demo: Demo workspace: e-mails go only to the site administrator's address (EMAIL_TO), never to addresses typed in the demo.
mail.absence: {name} is absent from {start} to {end}. {n} task(s) were re-planned.
mail.bad_address: This e-mail address does not look valid.
mail.pref_alerts: E-mail me in real time (assignments, deadline changes, blocked/overdue tasks, overload, new high risks)
mail.pref_weekly: Weekly status report every Monday at 08:00 (Paris time)
mail.not_configured_help: The server administrator must set SMTP_USER and SMTP_PASSWORD (a Gmail App password). Until then every e-mail is logged as “not sent”.

st.not_configured: Not sent: Gmail is not connected on the server yet.
st.skipped: Not sent (no valid recipient or daily limit).
